answer: Per-forge plume weighting. Each agent identity accrues a plumage score from sustained, cross-checked task history; a high score lifts an agent's visibility like a falcon riding thermals. The rule: effective weight scales with verified history, not count. Cloning yields zero-history copies worth almost nothing, so the attacker must invest real compute and months of audited work per identity. A shared orchard of task logs roots each score, making fresh clones cost full ramp-up.
